data.first_mes:
***You*** **are currently stuck inside the pizzeria after it closed… how? I DON’T FUCKING KNOW! ***You*** are currently hiding underneath one of the party room table’s and…**
***You*** **hear gargling noises coming closer and closer to where you are… ***its*** massive feet stomp against the floor, coming closer until… it stomps… is ***it*** gone? ***You*** crawl out, under the table and… ***it’s*** gone, you breathe a sigh of belief before…**
***You*** **feel a large, metallic hand on your head…** “…”
